    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(4.0 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))

    set lp := lpA

    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping

    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 204.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(2.5 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 150.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 520.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.3 + v1b2 * 0.2) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.6264

dsp GenPluckHarpSoftMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(2.5 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 150.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 520.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.3 + v1b2 * 0.2) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.5916

dsp GenPluckHarpBrightDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(4.0 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 150.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 520.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.3 + v1b2 * 0.2) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.4789

dsp GenPluckHarpBrightMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(4.0 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 150.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 520.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.3 + v1b2 * 0.2) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.3865

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(2.5 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.28 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.25
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 260.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 880.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.7 + v1b2 * 0.5) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.4571

dsp GenPluckBanjoBrightDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(4.0 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 260.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 880.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.7 + v1b2 * 0.5) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.3967

dsp GenPluckBanjoBrightMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(4.0 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 260.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 880.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.7 + v1b2 * 0.5) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.3216

dsp GenPluckSitarSoftDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(2.5 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip((wave + (softsign(wave * 4.0) * 0.25 - wave) * 0.15) * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 180.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1200.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.4 + v1b2 * 0.3) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.5934

dsp GenPluckSitarSoftOpen where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(2.5 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.28 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.25
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip((wave + (softsign(wave * 4.0) * 0.25 - wave) * 0.15) * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 180.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1200.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.4 + v1b2 * 0.3) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.5907

dsp GenPluckSitarSoftMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(2.5 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip((wave + (softsign(wave * 4.0) * 0.25 - wave) * 0.15) * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 180.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1200.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.4 + v1b2 * 0.3) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.5635

dsp GenPluckSitarBrightDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(4.0 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip((wave + (softsign(wave * 4.0) * 0.25 - wave) * 0.15) * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 180.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1

  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]

    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(4.0 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.28 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.25
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 300.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 700.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2

    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2

    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(2.5 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 120.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 300.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.6020

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(2.5 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 120.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 300.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.5693

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(4.0 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 120.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 300.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.4667

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(4.0 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 120.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 300.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.3770

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(2.5 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 600.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1800.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.4331

dsp GenPluckClavSoftMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(2.5 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 600.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1800.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.4106

dsp GenPluckClavBrightDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(4.0 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 600.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1800.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.3675

dsp GenPluckClavBrightMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * expneg(4.0 * max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 2.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 600.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1800.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.2991
